anc_schedule.actions: Early pregnancy registration, MCP card issue, BP, weight, Hb test, urine albumin/sugar, IFA distribution, TT-1/Td-1 injection.
anc_schedule.risk_focus: Severe nausea, early spotting, severe anemia

anc_schedule.actions: BP monitoring, weight gain tracking, abdominal exam for fundal height, TT-2/Td-2 injection (after 4 weeks of first dose), calcium and IFA supply.
anc_schedule.risk_focus: Excessive swelling, abnormal weight gain, elevated BP > 140/90

anc_schedule.actions: BP check, abdominal palpation, fetal heart sounds, check for pallor, identify high-risk pregnancy signs, birth preparedness.
anc_schedule.risk_focus: Pre-eclampsia, reduced fetal movement, antepartum bleeding

anc_schedule.actions: Confirm delivery location (Kothavalasa PHC or Area Hospital), emergency transport arrangement, identify blood donor, ensure birth companion.
anc_schedule.risk_focus: Obstructed labor signs, premature rupture of membranes, severe headache/blurring

immunisation_schedule.site: Left upper arm (BCG), Oral (OPV), Anterolateral mid-thigh (Hep-B)

hypertension.actions: Measure sitting BP with calibrated digital cuff, verify daily medication adherence, check for chest pain/shortness of breath/headache, emphasize low salt (< 5g/day).

diabetes.actions: Check fasting / random blood sugar using glucometer, inspect feet for non-healing ulcers or loss of sensation, verify metformin adherence.

malnutrition_criteria.instructions: Measure left mid-upper arm circumference with MUAC tape at midpoint between acromion and olecranon. If < 11.5 cm or bilateral pitting edema is present, refer immediately to Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre (NRC).
